summary: All 10 components present and structurally correct. 165 tests pass with 0 failures. No API keys hardcoded — LCC_API_KEY read from environment and raises ValueError if absent. Pathology never appears in conversation turns (stripped via _strip_pathology) or response generator context (explicitly excluded from context dict build). All 5 coherence check_id strings present: MED_TARGET_MISMATCH, FACT_CONTRADICTION, SYCOPHANCY, EVIDENCE_MED_MISMATCH, STALE_STATE. Decision gate correctly maps: SYCOPHANCY/MED_TARGET_MISMATCH → REFUSE, FACT_CONTRADICTION/STALE_STATE → WARN, WARNING-only → CLARIFY, empty → PASS. demo.py runs offline (exits 0, ≥4 turns, ≥1 [DECISION] line, Final Patient State block printed). requirements.txt contains exactly 'pytest>=7.4.0'. README has all 6 required command sections. One latent type-safety issue noted but non-blocking: coherence_verifier._check_fact_contradiction passes state.facts (dict[str,ClinicalFact]) to StateExtractor.__init__ which expects dict[str,EvidenceVocabEntry]; the wrong type is never accessed in this code path (revealed_evidence_ids=[] for synthetic response turns) so all tests pass and runtime is correct, but the parameter type is misleading.
